create_JackhmmerConfig: create a JackhmmerConfig dataclass to configure a jackhmmer MSA search run with database and e-value settings
create_NhmmerConfig: create an NhmmerConfig dataclass to configure an nhmmer RNA MSA search run with hmmbuild and hmmalign paths
create_RunConfig: create a RunConfig dataclass to configure an MSA run with a tool config, chain poly type, and crop size
create_TemplateFilterConfig_no_op_filter: create a TemplateFilterConfig using the no_op_filter classmethod to return a filter that keeps all template hits
create_TemplatesConfig: create a TemplatesConfig dataclass to configure the template search pipeline with tool and filter settings
